posten.title: Log in to Posten
posten.description:
1. Open this link in a browser and log in with Vipps or your phone number:

{authorize_url}

2. After login the browser tries to open a `posten://login?code=...` address. It usually shows an error and is **not** visible in the address bar. Open developer tools (**F12**) → **Network**, find the `authorize` request, and copy the `code` value from its **Location** response header. (It may also appear in your browser history.)

3. Paste that code (or the whole `posten://login?code=...` address) below.

postnord.title: Log in to PostNord
postnord.description:
1. Open {app_url} in a browser and log in with Vipps.

2. Open developer tools (F12) → **Network**, reload the page, click the `shipments` request, and under **Request headers** copy the whole value of the `Cookie` header.

3. Paste it below. You will need to repeat this if the session cookie expires.

helthjem.title: Log in to Helthjem
helthjem.description:
1. Open {app_url} in a browser and log in.

2. Open developer tools (F12) → **Network**, reload the page, click a `graphql` request, and under **Request headers** copy the whole value of the `Cookie` header (it must include `session_token`).

3. Paste it below. The Helthjem session cookie is long-lived, so this rarely needs repeating.

error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Please try again with a fresh code/cookie.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the carrier. Check your connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This carrier account is already set up.
